note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording the first edition carried — including the quotations the first edition's notes missed and the unmarked recitations.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the author's own paraphrases and invented dialogue, phrases recast to another person or number, scare-quoted labels that are not Scripture, bare citations with no quotation, and the one reading whose point hangs on a KJV word OWB does not use (Hebrews 10:23 'profession of our faith', which the author quotes in order to argue that 'elpis' means hope).
Block indexes follow the admin side-by-side view (library/requote.py); the first edition's rows sat one or two blocks off in several chapters and are corrected here.
